question: “Skilling of girls in non-traditional livelihood (NTL)” has been included in which flagship scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beti Bachao Beti Padao.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **“Skilling of girls in non-traditional livelihood (NTL)” **has been included in** **the** Beti Bachao Beti Padao scheme.**
 
• Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) is a government initiative** launched in India in 2015. **
 
• It aims to address the declining **child sex ratio and promote the education** and empowerment of girls.
